messages:
jamie: kicking off BCN1 cluster smoke window now — goal: validate GPU pool, networking, model pulls, and basic SLO gates. rolling 6 GPU nodes (bcn1-gpu-00[1-6]) for driver + runtime checks. will post quick commands below.
priya: on it. i'll run node readiness + prometheus scrapes, then run a couple of short inference jobs.
miguel: i'll validate rack networking and cross-AZ routes. FYI we had an mtu mismatch in staging last week so will check MTU and jumbo frames.
jamie: smoke checklist i'm using: 1) nodes Ready & kernel/drivers matching 2) nvidia-smi + torch cuda test 3) filesystem (model store) pulls 4) small inference qps latency p50/p95/p99 5) prometheus/alerting scrapes present 6) kube-proxy & CNI healthy 7) rollout & rollback exercises
jamie: quick commands: 
```
kubectl get nodes -l region=bcn1 -o wide
kubectl describe node bcn1-gpu-001 | egrep "Kernel|Kubelet Version|Capacity"
ssh ops@bcn1-gpu-001 sudo nvidia-smi
ssh ops@bcn1-gpu-001 sudo ip link show | grep mtu
python -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.is_available())"
```
miguel: ran `ip link show` on TOR, MTU is 1500 on one leaf, others 9000. that mismatch will cause fragmentation for large model pulls.
anya: model pull smoke: `rclone copy s3:staging-models/resnet50 /tmp/model --transfers 4 --dry-run` — dry run succeeded but actual pulls stalled earlier in staging when MTU was wrong.
priya: doing prometheus checks: node exporter scraping, cadvisor present, kube-state-metrics up. scrapes look good for 5/6 nodes. one node bcn1-gpu-003 shows 0 scrape (connection refused).
kyle: capacity check: target steady-state 80 concurrent small inferences, target p99 < 1200ms. initial reservation plan 6 x A100-equivalent yields ~65 concurrent; recommend 2 more on first commit or set burst policy. cost rough: ~11.5k USD/mo for reserved 8-GPU commit.
jamie: ok prioritize the network MTU & the scrape failure. miguel can you push the MTU fix to the leaf? would prefer config change at switch level then reboot nodes minimal.
miguel: will push change to leaf switch for the rack; need a 2-min maintenance window to avoid flapping. scheduling in 5m.
ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance: BCN1-rack-07 switch MTU update, start=2112223350, duration=2m.
priya: ps on bcn1-gpu-003 — kubelet failing due to stale docker runtime socket. I can restart kubelet after MTU change, but want to ensure no pod corruption.
jamie: go ahead w/ kubelet restart after MTU fix. add pre/post logs to the ticket.
miguel: MTU change applied. verified all leaves show 9000.
ops-bot: Maintenance completed: BCN1-rack-07 MTU update finished at=2112223355.
priya: restarted kubelet on bcn1-gpu-003, now node Ready. prometheus scrapes are green across all 6 nodes.
anya: retried model pull (non-dry): `rclone copy s3:staging-models/resnet50 /tmp/model --transfers 4` — pull completed in ~32s.
jamie: run quick inference smoke: start 10 parallel requests to endpoint on one pod, measuring p50/p95/p99.
priya: results: p50=90ms, p95=320ms, p99=980ms for single-node small-batched requests. within initial SLO (p99 < 1200ms).
kyle: given perf numbers and capacity calc, recommend initial commit 8 GPUs with autoscale burst to 12 for traffic ramp. file a reserved capacity PR.
jamie: logging checklist — saved node logs to s3 `s3://redwood-infra/logs/bcn1/21122233/` (kubelet, dmesg, nvidia-smi snapshots).
anya: model store IAM role check done, kms keys accessible. permissions OK.
priya: alerting sanity: rule `node_down` fires correctly when i cordon one node in test. alerts route to #oncall and pager duty test notification delivered.
jamie: final readiness gates: 
- nodes: Ready and drivers matching (PASS)
- networking: MTU uniform + no packet drops (PASS)
- model pull: verified (PASS)
- inference perf: p99 under SLO (PASS)
- metrics scrapes/alerts: verified (PASS)
- cost/capacity plan: PR needed (ACTION)
- handoff doc: create checklist + runbook link (ACTION)
priya: +1 on readiness. i'll draft the runbook snippet and attach to ticket.
kyle: i'll open the reserved capacity PR and add cost numbers + expiry.
miguel: will follow up with net config changes doc for BCN racks.
jamie: handing off to oncall for 24h watch. please ping if any regressions. created ticket INFRA-4521 with links to logs and runbook.
ops-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-4521 (BCN1 - initial bringup smoke & validation). assigned to oncall.
priya: nice — thumbs up all around :thumbsup:
jamie: thanks team. marking thread closed for the bringup window. re-open if anything pops up.
